(I get it! If we play all out, then I can...! 
—Yeah! Even the Voice of Destiny says so!)
"Getting to spend time together like this makes me really happy."

My eyes, huh? I see—hey, I know!
If you like 'em that much, you're welcome to take a closer look!

Ahaha! Sorry, got a bit carried away there!
Next up is... 'What's an embarrassing secret you haven't shared with your partner?' it says!

Excuse me, miss! Would you like a pair of horse-ear headbands?
You and your partner can match!

This game is amazing! I learned so much about you.
And I got to see plenty of new expressions, too! It was the best!

Where Epiphaneia points is the 'Heart-Pounding Compatibility Test'.
'Discover a new side to each other!?' the sign reads.

—Hey, what do you like about me, Trainer?
Won't you tell me?
Haha! I love that embarrassed look you're making right now, too!

Excuse me, sir! Would you like a pair of horse-ear headbands?
You and your partner can match!

'A new side,' it says! Hey, I wanna do this!!
Come on, let's do it, Trainer!!

(Are there other sides to you? I wanna see!
All kinds of expressions I don't know about yet...!)

I can't imagine anyone else! 
The destiny I discovered that day—it's only you!
...I want to see more and more!
—! Yeah, it's a promise!!

Me too! I got to see so many new sides to you, Senpai...
Um, if it's okay with you, would you want to go again sometime?!

Seeing you surprised or flustered is really cute, and whenever
I see you having fun, it makes me want to make you even happier!
Now it's your turn, Trainer! What was your first impression of me?!

Now isn't that an interesting question! I don't have any, but—how about you, Trainer?
From that reaction, you definitely do, right?! Come on, spill it!

The answer that came to mind was—her 'eyes.' Ever since the day
we met, I've always thought their comet-like sparkle was beautiful.

Yeah!
I mean, you don't have eyes for anyone else besides me either, right?
...Wait, what's with that look on your face? Were you seriously that terrified of the zombies?

Ohh...! Hahaha, yes, that thrilled smile right there!
I love it, Trainer! Yeah... it's awesome!!
"Now for the next question! What is your favorite thing about your partner?"

We really ended up playing our hearts out all day long, didn't we?
Thanks for inviting me out today!

Haha, I see!
Hmm... you're not smiling, but that expression is super fresh and interesting too!

Inside the cramped booth, I stand face-to-face with Epiphaneia.
The atmosphere radiating from the machine is... well, pretty embarrassing.

Oh, looks like no one's in line!
Perfect timing, let's play again!

Come on, look all you want! Ah, should I get closer?!
Alright, even closer—!

In that instant, my hand is tugged firmly,
and Epiphaneia's eyes loom right in front of mine.

"Please answer the randomized questions truthfully♡
First, starting with the person on the left—what was your first impression of your partner?"

No way, I'm not letting you go home yet!
There's still time until closing, and we haven't even seen the parade!

There might be questions we didn't get earlier, right? And I might get to
see more expressions of yours that I've never seen before! Right?!

Let's ride that first! Go-karts!
We're gonna hit max speed together!!

I tell her that the moment our eyes met, it felt like sparks exploded—
that's just how intense our encounter felt.

Already the next one? Let's see... your expressions!
Thinking about it today, they change constantly, so I never get tired of watching!

What's wrong with that?
I think a giddy look on your face is great too, Trainer!

Let's play our hearts out right up to the last second!
I'm sure I'll get to see new faces from you—the voice of destiny is telling me so!

—First impression?
My destiny!! I just knew it intuitively—it had to be you and no one else!
Say cheese!!
(GWAAAHHH!!)

I look at the picture the staff member took for us.
Both Epiphaneia and I, sporting fake horse ears, were captured with beaming smiles.
(THUD!!)
Let's go now! Right away! As fast as we can!!

"Face each other and stare deep into each other's eyes♡
Place one hand on the sensor—and the Heart-Throbbing Compatibility Test begins!"

After that, I ended up indulging Epiphaneia, who had taken quite a liking to
the "Compatibility Test," for multiple rounds—and before we knew it, the sun had fully set.

The world shakes, and stars dance before my eyes.
It seems Epiphaneia's enthusiastic charge ended in a massive headbutt.

Like I'd let you!! —You okay, Trainer?
Still, if it's like this right from the start, this is gonna be quite a challenge!

Ooh, that looks great on you! You look like an Umamusume too, Trainer!
Alright excuse me, could you take our picture too?!

Oh, looks like they're taking commemorative photos over there!
Why don't we get one taken too?!
The result is... 75%? Well, that's pretty good for our first try!

So we use these guns to take down the monsters. Alright, let's aim for the top score!
Trainer, stay right by my side!

—Look! It says 2 minutes 23.1 seconds!
We're by far the fastest!!

If I remember right, we haven't checked out this area yet, have we? An arcade, huh—
Oh! Doesn't that one look great?!

WOOOOAAAAHHH!!
If it's us, we can push it way further!!

—Yeah, I'm definitely glad we came to the amusement park!
I've seen nothing but new expressions from you all day!

—I knew it!
It's you!

! Did you see it too, Trainer?! The spark of destiny!
—Haha, guess that makes our feelings mutual!
(—Hehe! So that's the kind of face you make, Trainer!)

Whew, that was a blast!
Haven't we conquered all the questions by now?

One day off—Epiphaneia stormed in first thing in the morning and dragged me to an amusement park.
As usual, the "voice of destiny" seemed to be involved.
